meta_description: Nettio: know whether your laundry earns money, and on what.
review_not_found: This draft does not exist, or you may not decide it.
feedback_error: That did not work. Try again.
error_generic: That did not work. Try again.
perm_journal_read_body: See who did what in the app, agents included.
error_not_allowed: You are not allowed to do this. Ask the owner to grant it in “Team and rights”.
error_invalid_input: A value is not valid. Check the fields, then try again.
error_not_found: This item does not exist, or no longer. Reload the page.
error_amount: This amount is not valid: enter a whole number, no decimals.
error_already_set_up: The laundry is already set up: nothing changed. Change it in “Settings”.
error_not_set_up: The laundry is not set up yet. Begin with the start.
error_site_code_taken: This code already belongs to another site. Choose another: it prefixes deposit numbers.
error_site_plant_not_needed: This site processes laundry itself: it has no plant to send to. Remove the plant, or make it a counter.
error_site_plant_unknown: The chosen plant does not exist or does not process laundry. Choose a plant in use.
error_site_last_counter: At least one site must receive deposits. Keep this one in use, or open another first.
error_site_plant_in_use: Counters send their laundry to this plant. Attach them elsewhere before retiring it.
error_owner_keeps_everything: The owner keeps every right: this role cannot be changed.
error_route_not_for_this_nature: Only a workshop service has a route. Remove the steps, or choose the “workshop” nature.
error_route_step_unknown: A step of the route does not exist or is retired. Remove it from the route.
error_route_step_twice: A step appears twice in the route. Keep it once.
error_step_on_a_route: This step is on the route of a service in use. Remove it from that route first.
error_service_pricing_in_use: This service already has prices or packs: its pricing no longer changes. Create another service.
error_pack_service_wrong_mode: A pack in pieces only admits per-piece services, a pack by weight only per-kilo services.
perm_business_read_body: Read the sites, the catalogue, the prices and the diagram.
perm_settings_manage_body: Start the laundry, change its settings and its sites.
perm_staff_manage: Manage the team and its rights
perm_staff_manage_body: Give each person a role and tick what each role may do.
perm_catalog_manage_body: Change the services, their routes, the articles, the steps, the prices and the packs.
start_description: Three questions. Nettio prepares your sites, the usual workshop steps, four services with their routes and twelve articles. You can change everything afterwards.
profile_starting_hint: One site that receives and processes. Break-even is put forward.
profile_established_hint: One site that receives and processes, with a team.
profile_multi_site_hint: One plant, and counters that send it their laundry.
staffing_solo_hint: You hold every role: one screen, no validation to ask.
staffing_team_hint: Each person has a role and rights; sensitive gestures name their author.
start_site_description: Where your customers leave their laundry.
start_site_description_chain: Your first counter. Nettio also creates the plant it is attached to.
start_no_price: Nettio proposes no price: you will enter yours in the catalogue.
start_wait_title: The laundry is not set up yet
start_wait_body: Its owner must start it first. Come back afterwards: he will give you a role.
start_no_organization_title: Your account belongs to no organization
start_no_organization_body: Create your organization in Mon espace Kete, or ask your owner to invite you.
site_code_hint: One to three letters. It prefixes deposit numbers: A-0412.
site_plant_hint: The plant that processes what this counter receives.
sites_description: Where laundry is received, where it is processed, and which counter sends to which plant.
today_packs_without_service: {count} pack(s) with no service in use
today_no_role_body: The owner sees you in “Team and rights”: he must give you a role. Come back afterwards.
diagram_description: Drawn from your settings, redrawn at each change. Touch a site, a service or a step to set it.
flow_direct: From “received” to “ready”, with no workshop step
catalog_description: What you treat, what you do to it, through which steps, and at what price. A change never touches a past deposit.
catalog_no_service: No service. Add the first one.
catalog_no_article: No article. Add the first one.
catalog_no_step: No step. Add the first one.
catalog_no_pack_body: A pack is a fixed price for a quota of pieces or kilos. Nettio will tell you what each one earns you, on its real content.
service_active_hint: Retired, it stays on past deposits and leaves the counter.
route_add: Add a step to the route
route_remove: Remove the step from the route
price_never_proposed: Nettio never proposes a price: they are yours.
pack_services_hint: None ticked: every service of this mode is admitted.
team_description: Each person has a role; each role has rights, which you tick.
team_sites_hint: None ticked: she works at every site.
team_active_hint: Retired, the person no longer sees anything of the laundry.
team_invite_hint: To add someone: invite them to your organization from Mon espace Kete. At their first sign-in to Nettio, they appear here, waiting for a role.
team_rights_description: Choose a role, then tick what it may do. The change applies from the next action, on every screen, and to an agent acting for the person.
team_owner_all: The owner keeps every right: he cannot lock himself out.
settings_description: How your laundry works. These settings change no past deposit.
settings_counter_hint: The delays offered to the customer, express, and the discount an employee may grant alone.
settings_discount_ceiling_hint: Above it, the discount needs a person who has the right.
settings_dormant_days_hint: After that, it appears among the deposits to chase.
tracking_bag_hint: A deposit moves as one block per service: fast.
tracking_piece_hint: Each piece moves alone: precise, more gestures.
settings_costs_hint: What your costs and break-even are computed from. Nothing is estimated for you.
settings_labor_minute_cost: Cost of a minute of work (F CFA)
settings_labor_minute_cost_hint: The month’s wages divided by the minutes worked.
settings_labor_is_variable: The workshop is paid by the piece
settings_labor_is_variable_hint: Ticked: labor counts in each piece’s variable cost, not in fixed charges.
perm_customers_read_body: Read the name, phone and preferences of the laundry’s customers.
perm_customers_write_body: Create a customer, correct her name, phone, channel.
perm_orders_read_body: Read deposits, their content, state and history.
perm_orders_create_body: Record a deposit at the counter, with its real content.
perm_orders_cancel_body: Cancel a deposit that is not ready yet, with a reason.
perm_orders_discount: Grant a discount above the ceiling
perm_orders_discount_body: Exceed the discount anyone may grant alone.
perm_orders_release_unpaid_body: Hand over a deposit whose balance is not paid.
perm_payments_collect_body: Cash an advance or a balance, and hand a ready deposit over to its customer.
perm_payments_refund_body: Give money back on a deposit, with a reason.
perm_workshop_operate_body: Validate workshop steps, report an incident, mark a deposit ready.
settings_phone_prefix_hint: Added to numbers typed without a prefix: 228 for Togo.
counter_new_customer: Unknown number: a name is enough to create the customer.
counter_discount_above: This discount exceeds {ceiling} %: it needs a person who has the right. Lower it, or ask the manager to record the deposit.
counter_discount_above_yours: This discount exceeds {ceiling} %: you have the right, and it will be recorded under your name.
counter_no_site: None of your sites receives deposits. Ask the owner to give you one.
counter_no_price_body: The counter cannot sell anything until a price is entered. Add your prices in “Catalogue”.
customer_consent: Accepts the messages of her deposits
customer_consent_hint: Unticked: no message leaves for this customer any more.
customers_description: Found by name or phone. A customer is created at their first deposit.
customers_empty_body: They appear here from their first deposit.
orders_empty_body: Record the first one: it will appear here.
order_collect_paid: The deposit is paid: it can be handed over.
order_collect_unpaid_hint: You may hand over without settling: clear the amount. It will be recorded under your name.
order_confirm_cancel: Deposit {number} will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.
order_confirm_refund: {amount} will be given back on deposit {number}. This cannot be undone.
receipt_message: Hello {customer}. Deposit {number} received: {content}. Total {total}, paid {paid}, balance {balance}. Ready on {date}. — {business}
today_late: {count} deposit(s) promised and not ready yet
today_dormant_meta: Ready for longer than your delay
error_balance_due: {amount} is still due. Cash the balance, or ask a person who may hand over an unpaid deposit.
error_quantity_invalid: A quantity is not valid: a whole number of pieces, or a positive weight.
error_not_sold: A piece of the deposit has no price for this service. Add its price to the catalogue, or remove it.
error_discount_needs_reason: A discount needs a reason. Write it, then try again.
error_discount_above_ceiling: This discount exceeds the ceiling you may grant alone. Lower it, or ask the manager.
error_order_not_open: This deposit is no longer open: it is ready, collected or cancelled. Reload the page.
error_order_not_ready: This deposit is not ready yet: it cannot be handed over. Mark it ready first.
error_reason_needed: This gesture needs a reason. Write it, then try again.
error_refund_first: Money was cashed on this deposit. Refund it first, then cancel.
error_order_cancelled: This deposit is cancelled: it takes no more money.
error_payment_above_balance: This amount exceeds what is due. Enter the balance at most.
error_refund_above_paid: This amount exceeds what was paid. Enter that amount at most.
error_phone_invalid: This number is not a valid phone. Check it.
error_phone_taken: This number already belongs to another customer. Open their record, or correct the number.
error_customer_name_needed: This number is new: enter the customer’s name.
error_customer_needed: The deposit has no customer. Enter their phone.
error_site_does_not_receive: This site receives no deposits: it is a plant. Choose a counter.
error_not_your_site: You are not attached to this site. Choose one of yours, or ask the owner.
perm_cash_operate_body: Open one’s till, count it, close it, deposit at the bank.
perm_expenses_read_body: Read the month’s expenses and charges.
perm_expenses_write_body: Record an expense or a charge, void it with a reason, stop a recurring charge.
perm_draws_record_body: Note an owner’s draw: it is not an expense.
perm_money_read_body: See the result, costs, margins per pack, break-even, every till.
perm_costs_manage_body: Enter what each piece costs: minutes, consumables, machine.
till_description: Your till: its float, what came in, what went out, what it should hold. The gap is kept, never corrected.
till_none_body: Open yours with its float: cash will go into it by itself.
till_expected_how: Float + cash taken − refunds − expenses − draws − bank deposits.
till_counted_hint: Count first, enter afterwards: the expected amount is not corrected.
till_closed_right: Till closed: {counted} counted, it falls right.
till_closed_gap: Till closed: {counted} counted for {expected} expected. Gap: {gap}. It is kept as it is.
expenses_description: Everything that goes out: fixed or variable, one-off or every month. An error is voided with a reason, never erased.
expenses_fixed_hint: due even without a single deposit
expenses_empty_body: Add the first one: rent, wages, detergent, electricity.
behavior_fixed_hint: It falls due even with no deposit: rent, wages.
behavior_variable_hint: It rises with volume: detergent, electricity, hangers.
expenses_recurring_hint: It counts every month from its date, until you stop it.
expenses_stop_hint: Stopped, it still counts this month, then no more.
expenses_void_hint: Voided, it stays in the list, struck through, and counts nowhere.
expenses_void_confirm: “{label}” will be voided. This cannot be undone.
draws_description: What the owner takes for himself is not an expense of the laundry: it is noted apart, and deducted from what is left.
result_description: What you earn, and on what. Computed on cash really received: you can check it in your till.
break_even_sentence: You need to treat {month} pieces or kilos in the month to cover your fixed charges — {day} per working day. You are at {units}.
break_even_how: Fixed charges {fixed} ÷ what a piece leaves ({contribution}: it brings {revenue} on average and costs {cost} in variable costs), over {days} working days. The variable cost rests on {coverage} of the month’s pieces.
break_even_no_activity: No deposit this month: there is no break-even to compute yet.
break_even_no_sheet: No piece of this month has a cost sheet: break-even cannot be computed. Nothing is estimated for you.
break_even_no_contribution: A piece brings {revenue} on average and costs {cost} in variable costs: it leaves nothing to pay the fixed charges. At this level, no volume reaches break-even.
result_packs_description: Its price, minus the complete cost of its real content. A pack sold at a loss can be a choice: Nettio shows it, without judging.
result_no_pack_body: As soon as a deposit goes under a pack, its margin appears here.
result_below_cost: {count} deposit(s) this month went under the variable cost of their content. They are marked in their history.
result_reconciliation_description: What your sheets planned in variable costs for the volume treated, against your real variable expenses. The gap points to a wrong sheet or to waste.
result_planned_hint: by your sheets, on {coverage} of the pieces
result_real_hint: your variable expenses of the month
result_gap_under: you spend less than planned, or not everything is entered
result_how_cashed: Cashed = the month’s payments − refunds, every method together.
result_how_charges: Charges = the month’s expenses + running recurring charges. What you take is not a charge.
result_how_fixed: Fixed charges are spread over the month’s pieces in proportion to their minutes of work.
result_how_pack: A pack’s margin = its price − complete cost of the pieces it covered, on their real content.
result_how_never: A piece with no cost sheet has no cost: it is said “never measured”, never guessed.
costs_description: What each piece costs for each service: its minutes of work, its consumables, its machine. Measure at your place — weigh the detergent, time an ironing.
costs_missing: {count} piece(s) on sale have no cost sheet: their margin cannot be computed.
costs_no_price: Cost sheets are written for what you sell. Add your prices first.
costs_how_minutes: Complete cost = variable cost + share of the month’s fixed charges ({fixed}), spread over {minutes} minutes of work: {rate} F CFA a minute.
costs_how_units: Complete cost = variable cost + share of the month’s fixed charges ({fixed}), spread equally while no minute is known.
costs_labor_fixed: Labor counts in the fixed charges.
costs_labor_variable: The workshop is paid by the piece: {rate} F CFA a minute count in the variable cost.
costs_minutes_hint: Sorting, ironing, checking: time ten pieces, divide by ten.
costs_machine_hint: Electricity of a cycle, divided by the pieces of the cycle.
costs_origin: Where do these figures come from?
costs_measured_hint: Weighed, timed, read at your place.
costs_estimated_hint: An idea, to measure later: Nettio will say so beside every margin.
counter_below_cost: This deposit goes under its variable cost. You may record it: the owner will see it.
counter_below_cost_amount: This deposit goes under its variable cost ({cost}). You may record it: it will be marked in its history.
error_cash_session_needed: No till is open under your name at this site. Open your till in “Till”, or choose another payment method.
error_cash_session_open: You already have a till open at this site. Close it before opening another.
error_cash_session_closed: This till is already closed: its gap is kept as it is.
error_not_your_till: This till is not yours. Only its cashier, or a person who reads the money, may touch it.
error_cash_not_in_till: The till only holds {amount}. Enter that amount at most.
error_site_needed: Cash leaves a till at a site. Choose the site.
error_recurring_not_from_till: A recurring charge is not paid from the till. Choose the bank, Mobile Money or other.
error_stop_before_start: A charge cannot stop before it starts. Choose a date after its start.
result_pack_line: {sold} sold · price {price} · average cost of the content {cost}
workshop_description: What waits, step by step, the soonest promised first. One touch validates a step.
workshop_late_hint: deposits whose promised date has passed
workshop_empty_body: Deposits received at the counter appear here, step by step.
workshop_said_done: {number}: {done} done. This bag finished its route.
workshop_said_ready: {number} is ready: all its laundry finished its route.
workshop_back_to_hint: A rework: it is counted apart.
error_workshop_not_finished: Laundry of this deposit is still in the workshop. It will be ready when its last step is validated.
error_site_has_no_plant: This counter is attached to no plant. Attach it in “Sites”.
error_unit_finished: This laundry already finished its route. Reload the page.
error_step_not_on_route: This step is not before the one where the laundry waits. Choose a step already done.
perm_messages_read_body: Read what the laundry wrote to its customers, and what they answered.
perm_messages_manage_body: Turn each kind of message on, write its words, chase the deposits that sleep.
template_receipt: Hello {client}. Deposit {numero} received: {contenu}. Total {total}, paid {paye}, balance {reste}. Ready on {date}. — {pressing}
template_ready: Hello {client}. Your deposit {numero} is ready. Balance: {reste}. — {pressing}
template_reminder: Hello {client}. Your deposit {numero} is ready and waiting for you. Balance: {reste}. — {pressing}
reply_stopped: Noted: you will receive no more messages from {business}.
reply_linked: Noted: {business} will write to you here about your deposits. Answer “stop” to stop.
reply_none: You have no deposit in progress at {business}.
messages_description: Nothing leaves for your customers unless you turned it on. Messages leave in your name, on WhatsApp or Telegram as each customer chose.
messages_not_connected_hint: While a channel is not connected, its messages wait here: nothing is simulated. Meanwhile, a deposit’s receipt can be sent from your own messaging.
messages_kind_reminder_hint: When you chase the deposits that sleep — never by itself.
messages_provider_template_hint: WhatsApp only accepts a first message as an approved template, with these same words. Leave empty if you have none.
message_reason_telegram_not_linked: the customer has not opened your Telegram yet
message_reason_outside_window: WhatsApp needs an approved template to write first
message_reason_recipient_unreachable: the customer cannot be reached on this channel
receipt_telegram_link_hint: By opening it, the customer will receive their messages on Telegram.
error_template_empty: The message is empty. Write your words, then try again.
error_template_unknown_placeholder: This message names a value Nettio does not know. Keep only those of the list.
error_reminder_not_enabled: The reminder is not turned on. Turn it on and write its words, then chase.
perm_assistant_ask_body: Ask a question in plain words. The answer only rests on what the person may see.
statement_how: Every figure is computed by Nettio from your deposits, payments and expenses. No sentence is written by an AI.
statement_cashed: Cashed today: {amount}, for {received} deposit(s) received and {pieces} piece(s).
statement_ready: {count} ready deposit(s) wait for their customer.
statement_late: {count} deposit(s) are past their promised date.
statement_dormant: {count} ready deposit(s) have slept longer than your delay.
statement_below_cost: {count} deposit(s) this month went under their variable cost.
statement_till_gap: {cashier}’s till: closed with a gap of {gap}.
statement_month: This month: {cashed} cashed, {charges} of charges, result {result}.
ask_description: Ask your question, or ask for a gesture. Nettio answers from your figures and says where the answer comes from.
ask_not_connected_body: No model is configured for this Nettio. Your screens and your day’s statement work without it.
ask_budget_spent: This month’s budget of questions is spent. Your screens and your day’s statement remain available.
ask_suggestion_month: How much did I earn this month?
ask_suggestion_packs: Which pack earns me the least?
sign_in_not_registered: Sign-in is not available: this Nettio is not registered at the Compte Kete yet. A Kete operator must register it, then set its identifier on this deployment.
result_month_running: The month is not over: the fixed charges of the whole month are already counted, and spread over the pieces treated so far only. The result and the complete costs will improve as deposits come in.
dictate_understood: Nettio heard: “{said}”. Check the deposit below before saving.
dictate_not_found: Not in the deposit, to enter by hand or to add to the catalogue: {items}
dictate_not_connected: Entry in a sentence is not connected on this Nettio. Enter the deposit with the buttons.
dictate_no_voice: Dictation is not connected. Write the sentence, or enter the deposit with the buttons.
dictate_nothing_heard: Nettio heard nothing. Bring the phone closer and try again, or write the sentence.
dictate_mic_refused: The microphone is not available: allow it in the browser, or write the sentence.
perm_statement_send: Decide where the evening statement goes
perm_statement_send_body: Choose the hour and the addresses that receive the statement. Whoever receives it reads the laundry’s money: the month’s result and the owner’s draws included.
error_statement_no_destination: The statement has nowhere to go. Give an e-mail address, a WhatsApp number, or link Telegram, then save.
statement_linked: Noted: your laundry’s evening statement will arrive here. To stop, open Nettio → Evening statement.
statement_mail_footer: Each figure is computed by Nettio from your deposits, payments and expenses. To stop receiving this statement: Nettio → Evening statement.
delivery_description: The day’s statement, sent by itself every evening: what was cashed, what waits, the tills and their gaps, the month so far. You do not have to open Nettio nor to call.
delivery_enabled_hint: Off until you turn it on: nothing leaves without your decision.
delivery_hour_hint: Lomé time (universal time). The statement leaves within the hour that follows, with the figures of that moment.
delivery_where_hint: Whoever receives the statement reads the laundry’s money. Give only addresses of your own, or of someone you would show your result to.
delivery_whatsapp_hint: Yours. If you have not written to the laundry on WhatsApp for 24 hours, WhatsApp may refuse the message: the screen will tell you.
delivery_not_connected: {channel} is not connected on this Nettio: nothing will leave that way.
delivery_telegram_linked: Linked: the statement arrives on your Telegram
delivery_telegram_hint: Open this link on the phone that must receive the statement, then press “Start”. The link works once.
delivery_saved_on: Saved: the statement will leave every evening at {hour}:00.
delivery_saved_off: Saved: the statement does not leave by itself.
delivery_sent_now: Sent just now, to the saved addresses:
delivery_never: No statement has left by itself yet.
dictate_seen: Nettio read on the picture: “{seen}”. Check the deposit below before saving.
dictate_nothing_seen: Nettio found nothing of a deposit on this picture. Photograph a written list, or the laundry laid out piece by piece, close and well lit.
dictate_photo_unreadable: The picture could not be read. Take it again, or enter the deposit with the buttons.
perm_pay_read_body: Read the pieces each person passed in the workshop, what they earn her and what she was handed.
perm_pay_manage_body: Set what the laundry pays for one piece passed at each step.
error_paid_to_needs_wages: Money handed to a person of the team goes under “Wages”, on its day, not as a monthly expense. Choose “Wages” and untick “every month”.
expenses_paid_to_hint: For an advance or a pay: it will be deducted from what her work earns her, in “Work and pay”.
workshop_my_work: Your work this month: {pieces} piece(s) passed.
workshop_my_work_paid: Your work this month: {pieces} piece(s) passed — {earned} earned, {paid} already handed.
work_description: What each person did in the workshop, counted from the steps validated — and what it earns her at the rates you set.
work_nobody: No step validated nor money handed this month.
work_how: A piece counts for the person who validated its step. A piece that passes the same step again after a rework is counted apart and not paid a second time. “Already handed”: the “Wages” expenses where you said who the money was handed to.
work_rates_hint: What you pay for one piece (or one kilo) passed at each step. Leave empty a step that is not paid by the piece. Nettio proposes no rate.
work_no_step: No workshop step in the catalogue.
work_rate_removed: Saved: {step} is no longer paid by the piece.
basket_empty: Empty. Touch an article, dictate or photograph: several services fit in the same deposit.
basket_needs_customer: Enter the customer’s phone to save.
dictate_example: As you would say it: “4 shirts and 2 trousers for 90 12 34 56, Business pack”.
basket_needs_name: Enter the customer’s name to save.
perm_invoices_read_body: Read the invoices and credit notes, and each customer’s account.
perm_invoices_issue_body: Bill one deposit, or several deposits of the same customer.
perm_invoices_credit: Cancel an invoice with a credit note
perm_invoices_credit_body: An invoice is never deleted: a credit note cancels it, with its reason.
error_invoice_one_customer: An invoice is for one customer. Choose deposits of the same customer.
error_already_invoiced: One of these deposits is already on an invoice. Open its invoice, or cancel it with a credit note before billing again.
error_already_credited: This invoice is already cancelled by a credit note. Issue a new invoice for its deposits.
error_credit_note_final: A credit note is neither cashed nor cancelled. To correct, issue a new invoice.
invoice_credits: This credit note cancels invoice {number}. Reason:
invoice_credited_by: This invoice is cancelled by credit note {number}.
invoice_cash_hint: Still due: {due}. A smaller amount is an advance.
invoice_credit_hint: A credit note cancels this invoice: it stays as it was written, and its deposits can be billed again. Money already cashed stays on the deposits; giving it back is a refund, on the deposit’s page.
invoice_credit_confirm: Cancel the invoice with a credit note
invoices_description: An invoice is neither changed nor deleted: to correct, a credit note cancels it and a new invoice replaces it.
invoices_none_body: An invoice is issued from a deposit’s page, or from a customer’s page for several deposits at once.
invoices_mentions_hint: What is printed at the top of your invoices. An invoice already issued keeps the mentions of the day it was issued.
invoices_footer_hint: For example: your Mobile Money numbers, your payment terms.
invoices_vat_hint: Off: your invoices say “VAT not applicable”. On: VAT is shown inside your prices, which do not change.
invoices_mentions_saved: Saved: your next invoices will carry these mentions.
assistant_intro: Ask for a figure, a deposit, a customer — or a gesture to prepare.
assistant_prepared_hint: Nothing is done until you have verified and confirmed.
assistant_failed: The answer could not arrive. Ask again; your screens stay available.
assistant_how: Nettio only reads what you may see, computes no figure itself, advises no price and does nothing without your confirmation.
today_to_hand_over_none: No ready deposit waits for its customer.
alert_due_soon: {count} deposit(s) promised within 24 hours, not ready yet
alert_due_soon_meta: To take first in the workshop
alert_till_gap: {count} till(s) closed today with a gap: {gap}
alert_discount: {count} deposit(s) of today with a discount above your ceiling
alert_discount_meta: Each discount has its reason on the deposit’s page
alert_below_cost: {count} deposit(s) of this month went under their variable cost
explain_question_day: Explain my day’s figures: where each one comes from, and what deserves a look.
explain_question_result: Explain the result of month {month}: how it is computed, with its figures.
ask_link_hint: Tie your own messaging: you will ask your questions from there, with your rights. By message, Nettio only reads — a gesture is confirmed in the application. Write “stop” to untie.
ask_link_not_connected: Neither WhatsApp nor Telegram is connected on this Nettio: questions are asked here.
ask_link_whatsapp_how: To tie WhatsApp: send this code, as it is, to the laundry’s WhatsApp number, from your phone.
ask_link_tied: Noted: ask your questions here, Nettio answers with your rights. Write “stop” to untie.
ask_link_untied: Untied: Nettio will no longer answer here.
perm_presence_clock_body: Say oneself when one starts and when one is done.
perm_presence_read_body: Read who is at work, since when, and each person’s hours.
error_already_clocked_in: You already clocked in. Clock out when you are done.
error_not_clocked_in: You did not clock in: there is nothing to clock out of.
presence_how: Each person clocks in and out herself, from “Today”. Nettio corrects nothing: an omission shows, it is not made up.
manager_description: What waits for a decision: the team’s requests, complaints, unclaimed deposits, and who is expected today.
approval_asked: Request sent. Nothing changes on the deposit until a manager decides.
approval_confirm: {what} on deposit {number}: it will be done at once, in your name.
complaint_opened: Complaint opened. A manager finds it under “Manager”.
complaint_compensation_hint: What the laundry gives, 0 for none. The money itself leaves by a refund on the deposit or an expense.
unclaimed_none: No deposit has been ready for more than {days} days.
unclaimed_fee_charged: {amount} of storage fee added to deposit {number}.
unclaimed_warned: Notice kept for deposit {number}: it may leave the laundry in {days} days.
unclaimed_destination_hint: Given, sold, thrown away — and to whom.
unclaimed_confirm: Deposit {number} leaves the laundry for good. What was still owed ({given}) is given up. This cannot be undone.
rules_hint: These are your decisions: Nettio suggests none. With no fee per day, nothing is charged.
rules_fee_per_day: Storage fee per day after them (F CFA)
rules_abandon_days: Days between the notice and the release
rules_quick_switch: Switch person on a shared device
rules_quick_switch_hint: Each one takes over with a personal 6-digit code, and only holds the rights of her role.
schedule_how: Lateness reads here: expected, the hour passed, not clocked in yet. Hours are Lomé’s (universal time).
switch_off: The laundry has not turned on switching person. A manager turns it on under “Manager”, in “Your rules”.
switch_nobody: Nobody has chosen a code yet.
switch_my_code_hint: Not six times the same digit, not a run.
switch_my_code_set: You have a code. Choosing a new one replaces it.
switch_my_code_none: You have no code yet: choose one to take over on a shared device.
switch_code_saved: Code saved. Nobody can read it, not even the manager.
today_post_till_closed: Your till is closed: open it before taking cash
today_unclaimed: {count} unclaimed deposit(s) whose customer is not warned
perm_schedule_manage_body: Say each person’s days and hours.
perm_approvals_request_body: Ask a manager for a discount, a cancellation or a refund one may not do alone.
perm_approvals_decide_body: Grant or refuse what the team asks for.
perm_complaints_open_body: Write down a customer’s complaint on her deposit.
perm_complaints_resolve_body: Say what was decided and what the laundry gives.
perm_unclaimed_manage_body: Charge the storage fee, warn the customer, take an abandoned deposit out.
error_shift_invalid: These hours do not work. The end must come after the start, one shift per day.
error_already_decided: This request already got its answer. Reload the page.
error_no_storage_fee: Nothing to charge on this deposit: it is within its free days, or your rules set no fee.
error_already_noticed: This customer was already warned. The delay runs from that notice.
error_release_too_early: This deposit cannot leave yet. Warn its customer first, then let your delay run.
error_code_too_simple: This code is too easy to guess. Choose another one.
error_code_wrong: This is not the right code. Try again.
error_code_locked: Too many tries: this code is locked for 15 minutes. The person may also sign in with her Compte Kete.
error_quick_switch_off: The laundry has not turned on switching person.
decision_asked: {by} asks for: {what} on deposit {number} ({customer}). Reason: {reason}. Answer OUI {code} to grant, NON {code} to refuse.
decision_unknown: No request no. {code} is waiting for an answer. It may already have been decided.
counter_own_prices: This customer has {count} price(s) of her own: they apply.
credit_cashed_hint: The money the customer hands you.
credit_given_hint: Leave empty for the same amount. More, if you give a bonus — never less.
subscription_amount: What the customer pays each month (F CFA)
own_prices_hint: A price agreed with this customer replaces the catalogue’s, for her only. It is your decision: Nettio suggests none.
own_prices_none: None: this customer pays the catalogue’s prices.
own_price_saved: Price saved: it applies to her next deposits.
own_price_removed: Price removed: the catalogue applies again.
terms_none: Nothing agreed: this customer pays at each deposit.
terms_monthly_hint: Her deposits of the month are gathered on one invoice, from “Invoices”.
terms_payment_days_hint: Leave empty for your usual delay.
terms_saved: Terms saved: her next invoices will carry them.
quotes_description: A quote says what a job would cost, at this customer’s prices. It is written once: to change it, write another.
quote_footer: Prices set on the quantities announced; the deposit is billed on what is really received.
month_run_confirm: {count} invoice(s) for {month}: one per customer, with all her deposits of the month. An invoice cannot be changed.
perm_accounts_read_body: Her credit, subscriptions, prices and terms.
perm_accounts_manage_body: Set a customer’s price, her company terms, start or end a subscription.
perm_credit_top_up_body: Top up a customer’s credit, cash a subscription’s month.
perm_quotes_read_body: See the quotes and their answer.
perm_quotes_write_body: Write a quote for a customer and record her answer.
error_credit_below_cashed: The credit given cannot be less than the money received. Correct the amount.
error_credit_insufficient: This customer’s credit is not enough. Take the difference another way, or top up her credit.
error_subscription_not_running: This subscription does not run that month.
error_subscription_already_cashed: This month is already cashed for this subscription.
error_quote_expired: This quote no longer holds. Write a new one.
trip_description: Your round first, then what is planned today, then your zones and their fees.
trip_round_empty: Nothing to collect or deliver for you.
trip_started: On the way. The customer is told if she receives your messages.
trip_failed_said: Noted. The deposit stays at the laundry; another delivery may be planned.
trip_recipient_hint: The name of who takes the laundry: it is the proof of the hand-over.
trip_collected_said: {name}’s laundry collected. Record its deposit at the counter on arrival.
trip_plan_hint: A delivery is planned from the deposit’s page. A collection is planned here.
trip_planned_fee: It is planned. {fee} of delivery fee added to the deposit.
trip_cancelled_said: Delivery cancelled; its fee is taken off the deposit.
trip_no_zone: To deliver, first create a zone in
trip_zones_hint: Where you go, and what the trip costs the customer. These are your decisions: Nettio suggests none.
trip_zone_closed: Zone “{name}” closed: nothing more is planned there.
trip_on_the_way: {pressing}: your laundry ({numero}) is on its way. Our courier is coming.
perm_delivery_read_body: See what is planned, on the way, done.
perm_delivery_plan: Plan a collection or a delivery
perm_delivery_plan_body: Plan a trip, give it to a courier, cancel it.
perm_delivery_run_body: Leave, hand the laundry over, cash, note who received it.
error_balance_due_plain: A balance is still due on this deposit. Cash it before handing the laundry over.
error_address_needed: Give the address to go to.
error_zone_name_taken: A zone already has this name. Choose another one.
error_delivery_already_planned: A delivery is already planned for this deposit.
error_delivery_not_planned: This trip is no longer “planned”: it left, was done or was cancelled.
error_delivery_not_yours: This trip was given to someone else.
network_description: What travels between your sites, with its slip; what each site earns; the points a partner runs.
transfers_one_site: You have one site: nothing travels.
transfers_nothing: Nothing to send: every deposit is where it should be.
transfers_sent: {count} deposit(s) left for {to}, with their slip.
transfers_received_some: Slip {number} received: {missing} deposit(s) are missing. They are flagged.
transfers_missing: {count} deposit(s) a slip announced that nobody found on arrival: {numbers}. Look for them at the start and on the road.
sites_how: A site’s result = what it cashed − its charges − its part of the shared charges (those that name no site). The lines add up to the laundry’s result.
allocation_sales_hint: The site that received the most in value bears the most.
allocation_pieces_hint: The site that received the most pieces bears the most.
allocation_equal_hint: Each site bears the same part.
partners_hint: A counter run by a partner — a shop, a hotel — receives laundry for you. The commission is your decision: Nettio suggests none, and computes it on what the point received.
partner_commission: Commission of the month: {amount}. When you pay it, record it as an expense of this site.
partner_removed: {site} is no longer a partner point.
partner_percent_hint: On the sales received at this point. 0: none.
perm_transfers_read_body: See what travels between the sites.
perm_transfers_send_body: Send deposits to another site, with their slip.
perm_transfers_receive_body: Check a slip on arrival and flag what is missing.
error_transfer_same_site: The start and the destination are the same site.
error_transfer_empty: Tick at least one deposit to send.
error_transfer_not_here: One of these deposits is not at this site: it is elsewhere, already on the road, or flagged missing. Reload the page.
error_transfer_unknown_deposit: A ticked deposit is not on this slip.
stock_description: What is on your shelves, what to order, what was ordered and received, what you owe your suppliers.
stock_none: No consumable. Add your detergent, your hangers, your covers.
stock_unit_hint: As you count it: L, kg, piece, box.
stock_threshold_hint: At or under this level, Nettio tells you. Empty or 0: never.
stock_loss_hint: Spilled, expired, stolen — not used for the work.
stock_count_hint: Write what you really count. The gap with what Nettio thought is kept: it is not erased.
purchase_receive_hint: Write what really arrived and what it really cost. 0 for what did not come.
purchase_received: {number} received: the stock is up to date, and you owe it to {supplier}.
purchase_ordered: Order saved. Nothing enters the stock before the reception.
supplier_paid_from_hint: The payment becomes an expense of the day.
supplier_pay_confirm: {amount} paid to {name}: an expense is recorded today.
consumption_how: The plan comes from your cost sheets and the volume treated; {coverage} % of the volume has a sheet. A gap shows a wrong sheet, waste, or withdrawals nobody recorded.
consumption_unpriced: With no known cost, not counted: {names}.
perm_stock_read_body: See the levels, the orders, the suppliers.
perm_stock_move_body: Record what leaves the shelves and what arrives from a supplier.
perm_stock_manage_body: Create a consumable, its threshold, a supplier; take the inventory.
perm_purchases_order_body: Write a purchase order, or cancel it.
perm_suppliers_pay_body: Settle what the laundry owes; it is an expense.
error_stock_name_taken: A consumable already has this name.
error_supplier_name_taken: A supplier already has this name.
error_stock_insufficient: There is not that much in stock. If the shelf says otherwise, take the inventory.
error_purchase_not_open: This order was already received or cancelled.
error_reception_empty: Nothing arrived? Cancel the order rather than receiving it at zero.
error_payment_above_debt: This is more than you owe this supplier.
landing_title: Know whether your laundry really earns money
landing_lead: Nettio runs the counter, the workshop and the till of your laundry — and tells you every evening where you stand, on WhatsApp or Telegram.
landing_how: You come in with your Compte Kete. Nettio prepares your laundry in three questions; you type your prices, and you record your first deposit the same day.
landing_counter_body: The customer’s phone, her pieces in the basket — or a dictated sentence, or a photo of her list. The receipt leaves on her messaging.
landing_money_title: The day’s money, to the franc
landing_money_body: Each till opened, counted, closed with its gap. Expenses, what you take, and what is left: the month’s result, with no spreadsheet.
landing_workshop_title: A workshop that moves by itself
landing_workshop_body: A queue per step, sorted by promised date. One touch per step. The customer is told when it is ready.
landing_ask_body: “How much did I cash this week?” The figures are computed by the software, never invented. Nettio prepares a gesture; you confirm it.
landing_rules_body: It sets no price for you. It writes to your customers only if you decided so. It never cashes, cancels or refunds by itself.
landing_subscription: The subscription is taken and managed in your Compte Kete.
legal_to_complete: To be completed by the publisher before opening to the public.
legal_notice_body: Nettio is laundry management software, offered online. Each laundry that uses it remains responsible for what it records in it and for what it sends its customers.
privacy_who_body: The laundry decides what it records about its customers: it is responsible for that data. Nettio’s publisher hosts and processes it on the laundry’s behalf, and for nothing else.
privacy_what_body: For a customer of the laundry: her name, her phone, her preferred messaging, her deposits, payments, invoices, complaints, and the messages exchanged with the laundry. For a person of the team: her name, her role, her clockings, the gestures she makes in Nettio. Her personal code is never kept in clear.
privacy_why_body: To run the laundry: receive and return laundry, cash, invoice, tell the customer, pay the team, and know what the laundry earns. No data is sold nor used for advertising.
privacy_messages_body: A customer receives messages only if the laundry decided so and she accepted. She stops whenever she wants by answering “STOP”. Messages go through WhatsApp or Telegram, which process them under their own rules.
privacy_ai_body: When a person asks Nettio, dictates a deposit or photographs it, her question and the readings she may open are sent to a language model to word the answer. The model computes no figure and makes no gesture by itself. The laundry may not use these functions.
privacy_where_body: Each laundry’s data is separated from the others’, in the same database. It is kept while the laundry uses Nettio; accounting records — invoices, payments — as long as the law requires. The owner may export all her data at any time from “Help and data”.
privacy_rights_body: As a laundry’s customer, you may ask that laundry to see, correct or erase what it recorded about you, within the limits of its accounting duties. If the laundry does not answer, write to the publisher.
terms_use_body: Nettio is provided as described here and in its help. The figures it shows are computed from what your team recorded: a deposit not entered or an expense forgotten makes the result wrong.
terms_yours_body: Your prices, fees, discounts, storage and delivery rules; the mentions of your invoices and your tax duties; your customers’ consent before writing to them; who, in your team, may do what.
terms_account_body: You enter Nettio with a Compte Kete. Keep your access to yourself; on a shared device, each one takes over with her own code. The subscription is managed in your Compte Kete.
terms_data_body: You may export all of it at any time. If you stop Nettio, export it first; it is then erased, except what the law requires to keep.
terms_change_body: These terms may change; the date below says when. An important change is announced in Nettio before it applies.
help_description: What each role does, step by step. Your role comes first.
help_owner_1: Start with your prices: “Catalogue” → “Prices”. With no price, the counter cannot sell.
help_owner_2: Give everyone a role in “Team and rights”. A person with no role sees nothing.
help_owner_3: Every evening, read “Today” or receive the statement on WhatsApp or Telegram: “Evening statement”.
help_owner_4: “Result” says whether the month earns: cashed, charges, what you took, what is left.
help_owner_5: Your data is yours: export it at the bottom of this page.
help_manager_1: “Manager” gathers what waits for your decision: the team’s requests, complaints, unclaimed deposits, schedule.
help_manager_2: A request may also be granted by message: answer “OUI 12” or “NON 12” from your linked WhatsApp or Telegram.
help_manager_3: Close the tills in the evening: count, Nettio says the gap. The gap is kept, it is not corrected.
help_manager_4: “Stock and purchasing” says what to order before running out.
help_counter_1: “New deposit”: the customer’s phone, then her pieces. You may also dictate or photograph her list.
help_counter_2: To find a deposit: type its number, the name or the phone on “Today”.
help_counter_3: A discount above the ceiling, a cancellation, a refund: “Ask for an approval” on the deposit’s page.
help_counter_4: The customer complains? “Open a complaint” on the deposit’s page.
help_cashier_1: Open your till when you arrive, with the float counted.
help_cashier_2: Each cash payment enters your till; Mobile Money and card do not.
help_cashier_3: In the evening: count, close. Nettio says what the till should hold and the gap.
help_workshop_1: “Workshop”: each step’s queue, the soonest promised date first.
help_workshop_2: One touch validates a step. A damaged garment or one to redo: report the incident.
help_workshop_3: Record what you take out of the stock: it is what prevents running out.
help_courier_1: “Round”: what you have to collect and deliver, zone by zone.
help_courier_2: “I am leaving”, then “Handed over” with the name of who receives. Cash the balance before handing over.
help_courier_3: Cash enters your own till: open it before you leave.
help_accountant_2: An invoice is not changed: a credit note cancels it, a new one replaces it.
help_data_body: Everything your laundry recorded, in one file: customers, deposits, payments, invoices, expenses, stock. Personal codes and secret links are not in it.
access_until: Your access to Nettio runs until {date}.
access_none: Your Compte Kete shows no current Nettio subscription for this laundry.
access_manage: Manage my subscription in my Compte Kete
access_ended_banner: This laundry’s Nettio subscription is no longer current. The owner renews it in her Compte Kete.
